answer: Identity-bond decay blocks fake identities at the kernel of the registry: each identity locks a 100-token bond losing 2% per epoch unless refreshed by verified work. Idle bonds bleed into a lagoon of forfeited funds shared by honest agents, so a meadow of idle shells earns nothing and shrinks 20% in 10 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities costs 100,000 tokens plus 2,000 per epoch, while one honest agent pays 100 tokens once and keeps full rewards.
